messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: P2 ALERT — customer: Emerald Financial (emerald-dedicated-1, VPC). Automated checks show sustained spike in 5xxs and higher model-quality regression signal for tenant-bound traffic. Paging oncall-sre. Please ack and triage.
Mia Chen: acked. looking at logs in the dedicated pool now.
Samir (on-call): I’m on it. seeing 502/504s from runtime on a subset of workers in pool emerald-dedicated-1. Also telemetry shows rise in ‘hallucination_score’ for.*customer_prompt_set_A* starting ~2049000600.
Raj Patel: can you paste a couple of example error traces? Is this degraded latency or actual model output issues?
Samir (on-call): quick log snippet:
```
[2049001012] worker-12 | model-infer failed: KV cache invalidation error
[2049001013] worker-12 | fallback initiated -> variant=empty
[2049001020] telemetry | hallucination_score +0.27 for tenant emerald
```
Samir (on-call): it's both. a subset of requests get 5xx and others return strange completions (truncated/incoherent). pattern seems correlated with recent kernel rollout on those GPU nodes.
Liaison - Emerald: Emerald support here — customers noticing bad completions on their billing flows; one merchant reported a declined authorization because response parsing failed. Impact: revenue-affecting for a handful of customers. They want a quick safe fallback, low-risk.
Jen Ortiz: tagging product/security — any regulatory blockers for doing a tenant-scoped override in VPC? we should avoid broad network changes.
Infra-SRE: no KMS or networking implications for tenant-scoped routing overrides. safe to change routing at the control plane level for this tenant only.
Raj Patel: propose short-term mitigation: 1) pin Emerald's routing to a pre-quantized stable variant we call `emerald-safe-13b-v0` for 30m canary, 2) route remaining requests to Dedicated-stable pool workers (that didn't get kernel rollout), 3) maintain read-only metrics for rollback. Thoughts?
Mia Chen: sounds good. need to ensure KV cache compatibility — pinning to the safe variant avoids the new kernel code paths.
Samir (on-call): ready to apply. Suggested command to set tenant override (internal API):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/tenants/emerald/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "scope":"tenant",
    "force_model":"emerald-safe-13b-v0",
    "duration":"30m",
    "reason":"Live mitigation — model degradation after kernel rollout",
    "notify":"emerald-support@redwood"
  }'
```
Jen Ortiz: I need a one-line customer-impact statement to share with Emerald (ops). Samir, can you draft? keep it calm and non-technical.
Liaison - Emerald: they want something actionable — "We will route your inference traffic to a verified stable model variant while we investigate the underlying runtime regressions. Expected impact: zero customer-visible downtime; minor latency delta possible." That works for them.
Samir (on-call): applying override now. @Raj monitoring tracer and canary for errors.
Samir (on-call): override applied — control plane returned `200 OK` with id `ovr-9832`.
Oncall Bot: NOTE — routing override created for tenant emerald: ovr-9832 by Samir (on-call). Duration: 30m. :white_check_mark:
Raj Patel: starting canary metrics: watchlist = {5xx_rate, p95_latency, hallucination_score, token_cost}. dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/emerald/emerald-tenant
Mia Chen: initial 10 minutes in — 5xxs dropped from 16% -> 1.8% for emerald. hallucination_score down by 0.18. latency +30ms median (within SLO).
Liaison - Emerald: Emerald ops: confirming they see restored completion quality on their test flows. :thumbsup:
Jen Ortiz: good. escalation/communication plan: (1) keep override for 30m, (2) if metrics stay green at 30m, extend to 2h while infra rolls back kernel on affected nodes, (3) prepare RC/PM notes. assign postmortem owner.
Infra-SRE: we’re rolling kernel rollback on 4/6 affected nodes in emerald pool now — expected 45m to full cycle. will update.
Samir (on-call): creating temporary runbook entry in incident: `emerald-2049001234` with steps taken.
Samir (on-call): quick safety check — confirm override only affected emerald tenant, not all dedicated pools.
Infra-SRE: confirmed. routing change was tenant-scoped and applied in control plane. Verified with `GET /api/v1/overrides/ovr-9832` returns scope: tenant.
Raj Patel: monitoring 20m mark — metrics stable. recommend extend override to 2h to cover infra work.
Jen Ortiz: approve extension. Samir please update override to 2h.
Samir (on-call): patching override duration now.
```
PATCH https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/overrides/ovr-9832
Body: {"duration":"2h","notes":"extend while infra remediation runs"}
```
Samir (on-call): update returned 200. Oncall Bot notes updated.
Mia Chen: 1h in — 5xxs steady at ~1.5%, hallucination_score stable. No customer-reported failures in last 40m.
Infra-SRE: kernel rollback complete on all affected nodes. running full integration checks now (~10m).
Raj Patel: once infra verifies, plan is to remove tenant override and gradually route Emerald back to default routing that may include newer kernel nodes. rollout will be canaryed at 10% increments per minute with auto-rollback on >1% 5xx or hallucination delta >0.05.
Liaison - Emerald: Emerald product team appreciates the fast handling. Please send a short incident note and timeline when stable.
Samir (on-call): infra checks green. removing override in 5.
Samir (on-call): removed override `ovr-9832`. control plane returned 200. starting canary restore to default routing with 10% increments.
Oncall Bot: Canary restore started for tenant emerald. watch conditions active.
Mia Chen: after full restore, 5xxs remain ~1.6% and hallucination_score within baseline. p95 latency unchanged. all good.
Liaison - Emerald: they confirm normal behavior on production traffic. Thanks team.
Jen Ortiz: filing follow-up — owner: Raj Patel. timeline & RCA due EOD. Severity: P2, customer-impacting but mitigated without downtime. Will draft customer-facing note.
Raj Patel: noted. I’ll own the postmortem and include root cause hypothesis: kernel rollout -> KV cache mismatch -> model execution regressions on certain worker builds. Plan: add pre-rollout canary smoke tests for KV cache and a safeguard to autoscroll node version per pool.
Samir (on-call): incident CLOSED for paging. I’ll add runbook tweaks to the ops-runbooks repo.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — emerald incident 2049001234 closed. :white_check_mark:
Jen Ortiz: great work, everyone. follow-up items tracked in Jira: RED-9842 (postmortem), RED-9843 (pre-rollout smoke tests), RED-9844 (control plane override audit).
